newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai April CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Thai April CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr - ministry.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.3 percent year-on-year in April against a 4.5 percent rise in March, the Commerce Ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry said the CPI rose 0.2 percent month-on-month in April.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose to 138.3 in April from its 132.6 level in the same month a year ago.

NOTES: In the food and beverage category, rice and flour products surged 2.7 percent in April from March, meat and poultry and dairy products rose 0.4 percent while vegetables and fruit prices contracted 0.4 percent.
In the non-food group, transport and communications expenses rose 0.5 percent while clothes and housing prices rose 0.2 percent month-on-month.
